outline: This is an ESP course, and there will be various speaking and writing tasks in class. This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

flexible_learning.content:
1. 期末專題報告：依照教師提供之教材討論報告內容、製作簡報，並錄製期末報告影片上傳至指定平台。
2. 同儕互評：各組須到指定平台，依照教師提供之標準給予彼此質性回饋。
3. 線上單字練習：個人須到教師指定平台完成線上單字練習。
flexible_learning.outcome: 繳交簡報、口頭報告影片、同儕質性回饋、單字練習成績。

extended_resources: 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
